_comment: core_v3 sweep family: FEWER but HIGHER-quality sims that SUPERSEDE comparison_v2. 2000p/546 steps, M down to 1 (mean per node), S co-fit [3..35] ternary, GRF (sphere support) headline + a uniform_sphere control on cube26 only, the three MATCHED close-range treatments (none / bounded+substep / Plummer 1 Gpc), and vir_n_nodes=150 for a finer mass function + deeper interior. 12 core arms (9 grf + 3 cube26-uniform) isolate cube-vs-virialized-vs-softening cleanly; arm 13 is the B3a seed sweep. Run in sequence by launch_sweep_detached.ps1; each arm writes results/ws1_sweep_<tag>.csv (resumable).
